About me

Hi, I’m Syazwa Jalal, a Bachelor of Landscape Architecture graduate from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM). I enjoy turning site analysis into clear, usable design, from parks and streetscapes to community gardens.

Through my studio years I learned to work from site research to concept, master plan and detail drawings, and to present ideas clearly to clients and juries.

I’m looking for an opportunity to grow in a design practice, and I’m happy to talk about internships, junior roles and collaborations.

Studio projects

Final-year design thesis · Taman Wawasan, Putrajaya

Children’s Nature-Based Play Park

A play park built from open-ended natural materials, so children set the rules of the game. I designed the play spaces to encourage free, creative play in a natural setting.

Kuala Rompin, Pahang

Urban Mangrove Forest

A mangrove edge that filters river water and opens a boardwalk trail to residents. The design combines education and culture, so visitors learn about the mangrove while enjoying it.

  • Mangrove restoration
  • Boardwalk trail
  • Edu-cultural

Kuala Kangsar, Perak

Urban Streetscape

Rejuvenating an urban royal town by preserving its culture and authenticity. The streetscape keeps the town’s character while making the street more pleasant for people.
